root.label: Preview workflow
root.note: One preview lifecycle: prepare → seven parallel test jobs → finish. Parent durations include their children.

children.label: Prepare
children.note: One 16-core runner. Uses the shared preview environment.

children.label: Runner startup / unlogged setup
children.note: From Depot job start to the first checkout log. Includes runner initialization; individual operations are not timed.

children.label: Checkout
children.note: Sync the requested commit into the baked worktree. Ends at the next command start.

children.label: pnpm install
children.note: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline. Reconciles all 26 workspaces against the baked dependencies. The log says “Already up to date”; that does not make the command free.

children.label: Reset artifacts + checks
children.note: Remove old local reports, validate deployment epoch, and discover the 92-test catalogue.

children.label: Prepare deployment + readiness
children.note: Resolve PR/slot, erase old data, deploy selected apps, then wait for shared readiness.

children.label: Resolve PR, lease + deploy plan
children.note: CLI/Doppler startup, current PR head, preview lease and affected-app selection.

children.label: Clean old preview data
children.note: Whole pre-deploy erase. Removes DO state, auth D1 rows, KV keys and artifact repositories, plus Streams state. Artifact deletion hit its deadline with repositories remaining.

children.label: OS reset + D1 + KV
children.note: Includes OS erase startup, inspecting/resetting DO classes and clearing D1/KV.

children.label: Artifact repository cleanup window
children.note: 580 repositories deleted. This is the window between the KV completion and artifact deletion summary, not individually timed delete requests.

children.label: Remaining cleanup + deadline handling
children.note: Includes Streams cleanup and the artifact-deletion deadline message.

children.label: Deploy selected apps concurrently
children.note: Per-app measurements include configuration, build/deploy and deployed-version readiness. Dummy Petshop reuses a proven existing deployment.
